name: Kelly Morrison
page_title: Kelly Morrison's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic/Farmer/Labor for U.S. House (MN) - District 3

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As an OB-GYN, Kelly has dedicated her career to making sure women are able to make their own health care decisions without interference from the government. In the state legislature, Kelly helped lead the effort to pass a comprehensive legislative package protecting reproductive rights in Minnesota."

"Two years ago today, SCOTUS overturned Roe v. Wade. Since then, almost half the states have banned or restricted access to abortion, endangering the lives of women around the country. As a pro-choice OBGYN, I will fight for national protections of reproductive health care."

"We need to protect abortion rights at the national level. If elected, I will be the only pro-choice OB-GYN in the United States Congress. I helped lead the effort to protect reproductive rights here in Minnesota and I’m ready to take that fight to Congress."
Rated 92% by Pro-Choice Minnesota

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Kelly is strongly committed to protecting Medicare and Social Security to ensure that people can live in dignity in their senior years."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "A skilled workforce is the foundation of the economy, so we must train our workforce for the jobs of tomorrow, and ensure our unions are strong. Kelly also believes that we need a tax system that ensures opportunity for all."

"We need a robust economy that supports families, workers and businesses. Kelly is committed to lowering costs and building an economy that works for everyone. This means lowering the cost of everyday needs such as health care, housing and child care, while investing in innovation, infrastructure and entrepreneurship."

"this year’s state budget included an historic $4 billion in tax cuts, funding for health and human services, and education funding. It is unfortunate that the GOP walked away from this bipartisan deal."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "I’m excited our campaign has been endorsed by the Progressive Turnout Project! Protecting access to the ballot is a key component to protecting our democracy. Our campaign is committed to protecting and expanding voting rights for all Minnesotans."

"Kelly believes it’s time to put the voters back at the center of the decision-making process. One of the most important issues facing our state is protecting democracy and ensuring that all eligible voters are able to exercise their right to vote and to have their vote counted."
"She also passed legislation to allow automatic voter registration and put in place other key voting rights reforms in Minnesota."
"The biggest threat to election security is mis-and-disinformation about elections. We must ensure that as many eligible voters as possible can participate in democracy."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

"Kelly supported the passage of universal background checks and extreme risk protection orders in Minnesota and supports reinstating the ban on the sale of assault weapons. Kelly understands the urgency of curtailing gun violence and will continue to take this issue on in Congress."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "All Minnesotans deserve quality, affordable health care. As a practicing physician, Kelly has seen firsthand the out-of-control health care costs that rise every year. That’s why she has worked to lower health care costs during her time in the Minnesota legislature."

"Chief author of the Protect Access to Contraception Act @LaurieHalverson and I spoke at the Capitol about the importance of protecting access to affordable contraception. Insurance coverage of repro health care is at risk if the ACA is dismantled, so we must protect it in MN!"

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Busy morning at the Capitol with an update on election security in MN by @MNSteveSimon followed by a session on Universal Family Care, which would include early child care and education, paid family leave and long term care."

"Paid Family and Medical Leave passed off the Senate floor! Chief authors @DrAliceMann & @RuthForHouse have led with passion, intelligence & resolve. This transformative legislation is a win for Minnesota children, families & workers. So much gratitude to these remarkable women!"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "My bill to create a Prescription Drug Affordability Board passed out of Judiciary today. Next stop: State Gov’t. Drugs don’t work if people can’t afford them. MN can do better to ensure people have access to the Rx drugs they need."

"Proud to author legislation to help Minnesotans afford the medications they need to survive and thrive. I will continue to prioritize bringing down the high price of prescription drugs if elected to the MN Senate!"
"She took on Big Pharma and passed legislation to lower prescription drug prices, including capping the price of insulin from $600/month to $35/month."

"Thanks to all who came to our community conversation on the high cost of insulin and prescription drugs. The stories were heartbreaking and infuriating. People should not have to chose between the medicine they need to live and food."
